definitions.short: Sharetser , the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite
definitions.full: H8272. Sharetser or Saretser שַׂרְאֶ֫צֶר proper name, masculine in Assyrian (Babylonian) (van d. H. ׳שׁ , but see Baer, and Str ZMG xxxiii (1879), 302 ; in Assyrian perhaps [ Ašur, Bêl , or Nergal ] šar-uƒur , [...] protect the king ! COT 2Kin 19:37 ; Σαρασα ( ρ )); — 1 son of Sennach. , 2Kin 19:37 = Isa 37:38 (Schr COT l.c. Wkl KAT 3, 84 Stevenson Hast. DB. iv. 476 ). 2 a returned exile Zech 7:2 (Stevenson ib. 477 ). — compare also שׂ ׳נֵרְגַּל p. 669.
